subject.title: Discord DMs: inbound messages silently dropped (outbound works)

question: Should Discord account-scoped `allowFrom` replace the root allowlist as current docs/tests say, or should root and account `allowFrom` be unioned for inbound DMs?
rationale: The obvious repair changes who is authorized to start Discord DM agent sessions, so code inspection alone should not choose the security contract.

options.title: Preserve Account Narrowing
options.body: Keep account-scoped `allowFrom` as the default narrowing boundary unless maintainers add a documented migration or explicit opt-in broader behavior.

options.title: Union Root And Account Lists
options.body: Allow root-listed users through account DMs too, which addresses this report's proposed root cause but broadens access for narrowed accounts.

options.title: Require Explicit Account Lists
options.body: Treat this as setup diagnostics and documentation work, requiring every allowed DM sender to be listed on the receiving account.

recommendation.title: Preserve Account Narrowing
recommendation.body: Keep account-scoped `allowFrom` as the default narrowing boundary unless maintainers add a documented migration or explicit opt-in broader behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision sits in the shared account config and Discord DM access code where recent history points most strongly to steipete.
